controls: Formal-lex regression control bound to the exact EXP-SGCP-EMBED-001 fixture and objective receipt.
Thirty-one deterministic within-fiber SHA-256 controls with exact v6 domain separation and complete factor-base digest; duplicates are retained and disclosed.
Four fixed coordinate-chart encodings u in {1,-1,2,3}; no best-chart selection, and canonical induced-fixture digest multiplicities are disclosed.
Reverse and hash-ranked source-label permutations with selected affine-pair equivariance.
Frozen synthetic two-fiber representative positive control where least-slope derivation produces the exhaustive uniquely optimal table.
Frozen multiplicity-rich tiny fixture with exhaustive enumeration of every representative table and score.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Confirmed schema, arithmetic, semantic, embedding, accounting, malformed-output, or verifier mismatches are INVALID. Resource, optimizer, process, publication, infrastructure, or partial-matrix failures are INCONCLUSIVE. Then apply precedence VACUOUS, PASS_PROMOTE, CHART, MECHANISM, NO_SIGNAL; only the four scoped-negative outcomes weaken the hypothesis.
invalidation_rules: Reject singular curves, composite group order, trace 0 or 1, j-invariant 0 or 1728, or non-distinct registered chart scalars.
Reject a factor base that is not exactly size 6, sign-complete, duplicate-free, and generated by the frozen random-x transcript.
Reject any scalar-index input to a candidate or control compiler.
Reject any mismatch in semantic two-sum output classes, complete factor-base digest, or witness fibers across candidate and controls.
Reject any failure of source-permutation equivariance, injectivity, associativity, unique factorization, acyclicity, final-edge exclusion, or witness lift.
Reject any compiler/cap cell with reused process state, caches, incumbent, frontier, or compiler-dependent branch order.
Reject any run without separated shared, producer, optimizer, verifier, storage, and failed-attempt accounting.

Classify optimizer timeout, resource refusal, partial matrix, process failure, publication failure, or infrastructure failure as INCONCLUSIVE; classify malformed output or confirmed independent-verifier disagreement as INVALID.

primary: exact retained eight-term support finite rank among candidate plus 31 controls
same-cap replication across curves, factor-base seeds, and all coordinate charts
secondary: nonsingleton fiber count, exact choice product, candidate/formal-lex Hamming distance, unique control tables, and unique control objective vectors
common slot count, compiler-specific flattened formal multisets, duplicate collapses, semantic four-sum support, eligible vertices, conflict edges, and exact rational density
field and EC operations, branches, comparisons, sort keys, hashes, and hash input bytes
table, deduplication, graph, final-pair, optimizer, bound, cache, and failed-attempt operations
complete objective vectors, bounds, gaps, nodes, frontiers, and independent replay
canonical artifact bytes, retained advice bytes, temporary bytes, logical and physical I/O, CPU time, wall time, isolated peak RSS, and storage

experiment.objective: Test whether a fixed-chart least-slope section of actual EC pair-sum fibers changes the compiler-specific formal universe in a chart-robust way that lowers normalized conflict density and increases exact retained eight-term structured embedding support.
required_artifacts: v6 contract, literature note, reviews, protocol-consistency receipt, and coordinator decision
frozen positive, negative, tiny exhaustive, chart, and source-permutation controls
producer, optimizer, and independent-verifier source hashes
immutable manifests, commands, curve and factor-base attempt transcripts
candidate and all control representative tables
complete shared, producer, optimizer, verifier, storage, and failed-attempt ledgers
stopping_rules: Do not implement or execute while maximum_runs is zero or approved_by is null.
Stop before implementation if a fresh v6 theory or red-team review returns REVISE or NO-GO.
Stop and record INCONCLUSIVE if any exact optimizer cell cannot prove the full objective under a future approved budget.
Do not select a chart, cap, curve, factor-base draw, or control after observing results.
Do not infer an exponent or ECDLP improvement from this structural preflight.
experiment.success_criterion: PASS_PROMOTE requires one same cap fraction in {1/2,3/4} and a set of at least two curve seeds where, for each selected curve, at least two factor-base seeds pass every one of four charts on both strict support rank 1/32 and strict normalized-conflict-density rank 1/32 on the same cells. All nonvacuity gates pass and ties fail. This is not a p-value.
experiment.title: Fixed-chart slope representative compiler preflight
